editor.hint: Settings come from the profile. You sign in to Vault or OpenBao with OIDC when you connect. No secrets are stored.

profiles.name: Friendly Name
profiles.validationError: Name, server address and SSH signer role are required

dialog.title: Sign-in required
dialog.description: A window has opened to sign in to {{provider}}. Finish the sign-in there and this connection will carry on by itself.

use.title: Use SSH certificate signing
use.description: Create signer profiles and connect to hosts that use Vault or OpenBao.

share.title: Share signer profiles
share.description: Mark a signer profile as shared so every user can pick it.

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Add this URL to allowed_redirect_uris in each Vault or OpenBao OIDC role that Termix signs in with.

privateHosts.label: Allowed private signer hosts
privateHosts.description: Private or loopback Vault or OpenBao hostnames or IPs that anyone's own profile may use. Shared profiles and profiles made by people who can share already may. Separate entries with commas or new lines.

plugin.name: SSH Certificate Signer
plugin.description: Connect to hosts with short-lived SSH certificates signed by HashiCorp Vault or OpenBao.

resultPage.closing: You can close this window and go back to Termix.
resultPage.tryAgain: Close this window and try again from Termix.
